model-value.desc: Model of the component; use v-model directive

val.desc: Works when model is Array. Value to add/remove when ticked/unticked

true-value.desc: What model value should be considered as checked/on?

false-value.desc: What model value should be considered as unchecked/off?

label.desc: Label to display along the component

left-label.desc: Label should be displayed on the left side

checked-icon.desc: Icon to use when the toggle is on

unchecked-icon.desc: Icon to use when the toggle is off

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

keep-color.desc: Keep color when the component is unticked/off

size.desc: Size in CSS units or standard size name (xs|sm|md|lg|xl)

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

toggle-indeterminate.desc: Toggle through the indeterminate state too on click

default.desc: Default slot can be used as label, unless 'label' prop is specified

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model
